desc.zh: 用剩余次数回溯，既检查相邻平方和，又避免重复排列。
desc.en: Track remaining counts to build legal squareful orders without duplicates.

complexity: O(n*n! + k²) time; O(n + k²) auxiliary space, k distinct values

concepts.name: Remaining-count backtracking invariant
concepts.description: Consume and restore one copy per distinct value to enumerate each legal value sequence exactly once.
